parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the IDaaS EIAM instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100. If you set this parameter to 0, the default value is used.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The NextToken returned by the previous call.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Filters by the exact normalized origin.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filters by exact status. Valid values: Enabled or Disabled.

parameters.name: TrustedOriginScene
parameters.description: Filters by exact trusted origin scene. You can specify at most one value.
